## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to link a concrete [`gmeow:Prompt`](../classes/gmeow-Prompt.md) to the single [`gmeow:PromptTemplate`](../classes/gmeow-PromptTemplate.md) version it was filled from, so an output traces to the exact published template.

### Avoid when

- Avoid pointing it at another concrete prompt or at the model (the range is a template) and avoid more than one template per prompt — it is functional.

### How to use

- Assert exactly one [`gmeow:filledFrom`](gmeow-filledFrom.md) per templated [`Prompt`](../classes/gmeow-Prompt.md) at a [`gmeow:PromptTemplate`](../classes/gmeow-PromptTemplate.md); omit it for ad-hoc prompts that instantiate no published template.

### Examples

- ex:userPrompt [`gmeow:filledFrom`](gmeow-filledFrom.md) ex:extractTmpl.
